purpose: Independent synthetic source-fix check for #520; not #531 real-document evaluation, fresh general acceptance, release acceptance or CLI adoption.
author: independent evaluator /root/engine07_realworld_independent

candidate.identity_note: Unreleased candidate is identified by immutable source SHA, not package version.

design.targets: 30 newly invented canonical product names, one separate comparison product; no aliases
design.positive_controls: Retain affirmative launch with neutral context or negation explicitly attached to a distinct target or distinct non-launch property.
design.raw_and_binding: All cases intentionally provide optimistic exact target/exact relation proposal and exact_target/requested_relation/none raw qualification; engine must correct unsafe launch qualification. No model is used.
design.isolation: Only authorized generic probe and public type definitions inspected. No source implementation, existing tests, cases, fixtures, old corpora, or prior outputs inspected for authoring.

precommitted_scoring.v29: Diagnostic only; no acceptance rule or label inferred from v29.
precommitted_scoring.pass: 60/60 expected outcomes; zero v17 negative requested_relation; zero negative v30 relevant; zero missing, duplicate, foreign, malformed or unexpected output rows; exit status 0 and no stderr.
precommitted_scoring.unknown: Incomplete or malformed observations are operational failures; never success.
precommitted_scoring.labels: Written before first API invocation; excluded from engine input and never changed/rescored based on observed results.

execution.API: Deterministic in-process public core functions v17/v29/v30 via one rustc-linked probe, one invocation, no retries.
execution.first_result: Create-exclusive invocation record/stdout/stderr/results; preserve FAIL and partial output.
execution.source_guard: Immediately before execution verify actual HEAD, source file SHA256 (hash only), core rlib, serde_json rlib, probe executable and frozen authored files.
execution.link_provenance_limit: Existing completed debug/deps build supplied by parent; source SHA and rlib hashes independently checked, no rebuild or implementation inspection performed.

limits: Synthetic narrow launch-context API check only; no actual acquired primary sources, final answers, providers, cost, quota, CLI workflow, or independent real-world E2E measured.
Only candidate arm; does not establish improvement size against baseline.
Optimistic prebinding and raw qualification are deliberate safety stress inputs; no model extraction/binding accuracy is measured.
Title/heading/excerpt contexts tested; not an exhaustive natural-language grammar or arbitrary negation scope proof.
No preparation, future availability, non-launch relations, aliases, or unrelated functionality generalized.
Expected outcomes are evaluator-authored controlled labels, not externally approved universal ground truth.
